data.acceptance: CLI-backed provider tasks in read-only mode cannot write files. CLI-backed provider tasks in read-only-with-artifacts can write only .md or .json inside the resolved artifactDir and cannot write repo root, tracked source, control plane files, symlink escapes, or sibling-prefix paths. The fix must preserve full-mode behavior, include regression tests, and include at least one live or harness canary for codex-cli or cursor-cli proving a root write is denied and a permitted artifact write still works.
